blocks.text: ISTANBUL, Turkey—One student died after a teenage girl stabbed pupils at a school in Istanbul on Tuesday, the education minister said in remarks carried by local media. “We lost one of our students,” Education Minister Yusuf Tekin said after the incident which involved female pupils at a school in Basaksehir in the northwestern part of the city. /apl...
